note: Fuzzer passes raw attacker-controlled bytes as an OpenFlow message to ofp_print for parsing.
The crafted OpenFlow 1.4 port stats reply message is decoded, dispatching to ofputil_pull_ofp14_port_stats.
Extracts the Intel custom statistics property from the port stats entry; the property payload size equals the attacker-controlled length field.
Casts the property payload to the 16-byte intel_port_custom_stats header; msg_size is set from the attacker-controlled length field.
Attacker sets stats_array_size to 1, causing the loop body to execute at least once.
current points to offset 16 in the payload, which is exactly one byte past the end of the 16-byte property buffer.
VULNERABILITY: Reads *current (byte at offset 16) BEFORE any bounds check. Since the payload is only 16 bytes, this dereferences one byte past the buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overread.
The bounds check occurs AFTER the out-of-bounds read; the overread has already happened and is detected by ASan.
